findings: Broad/contextual retrieval benefits from semantic-first guidance.
Exact-notes lookups fail if speaker filters are treated as primary selectors; concept/phrase-first retrieval works better.
Day-audit queries need date-bounded session listing plus transcript fallback when segments are empty.
The service can return empty `segments` alongside usable `session.refined_transcript` or `session.canonical_transcript`; the skill must treat those as first-class sources.
final_recommendation: Use the updated skill. The biggest remaining risk was exact-notes retrieval, and the final concept-first patch fixed the measured regression on the Peter case.
